displayName: Allow embedded TrueType fonts to be sent in messages (User)
description:
This policy setting controls whether embedded TrueType fonts can be sent in messages.

        By default, embedded TrueType fonts aren't allowed in messages. Allowing embedded TrueType fonts Isn't recommended because of security concerns.

        If you enable this policy setting, embedded TrueType fonts can be sent in messages.

        If you disable or don’t configure this policy setting, embedded TrueType fonts can't be sent in messages.
